band.description: HAM band identifier when radio_service is HAM.

callsign_used.description: The callsign used for this QSO. May differ from the user's own callsign when using a shared/authorized callsign. Retained historically even if authorization is later revoked.

contact_name.description: Name of the operator contacted (optional, complements the callsign).

pota_activation_id.description: The PotaActivation this contact was logged during, if any. Links POTA contacts back to the main logbook.

pota_park_name.description: Snapshot of the POTA park name when this contact was logged during an activation.

sota_activation_id.description: SotaActivation this contact was logged during, if any.

qsl_sent.description: QSL Management: whether a QSL has been sent for this contact.

qsl_sent_via.description: How the QSL was sent (ADIF QSL_SENT_VIA).

qsl_received.description: QSL Management: whether the other station's QSL has been received. Received contacts count as confirmed in the Awards Tracker.

qsl_received_via.description: How the QSL was received (ADIF QSL_RCVD_VIA).

contest_name.description: Contest Logging: contest identifier (ADIF CONTEST_ID / Cabrillo CONTEST), when logged in contest mode.

contest_exchange_sent.description: Contest exchange sent, including any serial number (ADIF STX_STRING).

sota_ref.description: SOTA: summit reference of the OTHER station (summit-to-summit or chaser contact), e.g. W7W/KG-001 (ADIF SOTA_REF).

my_sota_ref.description: SOTA: summit this member was activating when the contact was made, e.g. W7W/KG-001 (ADIF MY_SOTA_REF).

qrz_logid.description: QRZ Logbook sync: the QRZ logid once this contact is in the member's QRZ logbook (or 'duplicate' when QRZ already had it). Empty means not uploaded.
